# 📊 Hyperliquid Trader Behavior vs. Market Sentiment

This repository contains a comprehensive analysis of the correlation between the Bitcoin **Fear & Greed Index** and trader performance on the **Hyperliquid DEX**. 

## Repository Structure
* **`assignment.ipynb`**: The main research notebook covering data cleaning, exploratory analysis (EDA), and machine learning (K-Means Clustering).
* **`app.py`**: A bonus interactive Streamlit dashboard for real-time data exploration.
* **`processed_metrics.csv`**: The aggregated dataset generated by the analysis.
* **`requirements.txt`**: List of dependencies (Pandas, Seaborn, Scikit-Learn, Streamlit, Plotly).

---
